areas.name: Dwarven Mine entrance
areas.notes: The world map's "Dwarven Mine" label, on Ice Mountain; the mine itself is the underground area dwarven-mine.

areas.name: Hemenster
areas.notes: The Fishing Contest town west of the Ranging Guild, from the river (x 2623) to the guild fence: Morris at its gate (2643, 3440), the contest spots west of the fence at x 2642 and Grandpa Jack (2650, 3452) (quests/quest_fishingcompo). The world map label sits at the guild door.

areas.name: Lighthouse
areas.notes: Past the broken bridge (oploc1,horror_broken_bridge_left_spot, quests/quest_horror/scripts/quest_horror.rs2:63), which the player jumps, a failed jump still landing across (:102), or walks once Horror from the Deep has it mended; inside, the doorway needs Horror from the Deep done (quest_horror.rs2:3) and the stairs up are a script of their own (quest_horror.rs2:186, outside ladders+stairs/). The world index has the bridge and the stairs as scripted crossing rows (sources/gate-landings.ts), so the shop reads Horror from the Deep.

areas.name: Ranging Guild
areas.notes: The grounds inside the guild's wooden barricade (wood_wall_barricadel in map square m41_53), a diamond whose inside is |x - 2668| + |z - 3428| <= 17 with a watchtower at each tip. The guild door (2658, 3438) is in its north-west side and needs 40 Ranged (minigames/game_ranging/scripts/ranging_guild_door.rs2).

areas.name: Tree Gnome Stronghold
areas.notes: The entrance gate (oploc1,gnome_areagate, areas/area_gnome/scripts/gnome_gate.rs2:2) lets a settled account through by a scripted forcemove, either way (:57, :59), while the collision data has it shut; gates.ts has it a temporary block, so the world index crosses it by scripted crossing rows (sources/gate-landings.ts), as it does the Grand Tree's doors (oploc1,treedoorl and treedoorr, gnome_gate.rs2:63), which move the player by script too.

areas.name: Tree Gnome Village
areas.notes: Entered through the loose railing (oploc1,treegnomelooserailing, areas/area_gnome/scripts/gnomevillage_fence.rs2:1), a squeeze with no condition, one tile either way; the world index has it as a scripted crossing row (sources/gate-landings.ts).

areas.name: Underground Pass entrance
areas.notes: The world map's "Underground Pass" label; the pass itself is the underground area underground-pass.

areas.name: Ape Atoll
areas.notes: Marim and the Monkey Madness jungle (quests/quest_mm npcs). Reached by Monkey Madness's rides, which teleport from npc dialogue rather than a sail proc (gates.ts CURATED_CROSSINGS): Daero's blindfold to the glider hangar for a player past the quest's training (quests/quest_mm/scripts/mm_daero.rs2:235), Waydar's glider to Crash Island (mm_waydar.rs2:116), then Lumdo's boat (mm_lumdo.rs2:24).

areas.notes: Lumdo and Waydar (quests/quest_mm npcs).

areas.name: Varrock East mine

areas.name: Al Kharid river

areas.name: Duel Arena bank
areas.notes: Fadli, and the two closed bank chests beside him that open into bank chests (minigames/game_duelarena/scripts/misc_locs.rs2).

areas.name: Shantay Pass bank chest
areas.notes: Members only; opens the bank (areas/area_alkharid/scripts/shantay_chest.rs2).

areas.name: Tirannwn
areas.notes: The world index's walk from the Lumbridge spawn reaches Isafdar through Regicide's forest crossings (oploc1,_regicide_cross_over, quests/quest_regicide/scripts/quest_regicide.rs2:389), and the Tyras camp's general store at (2194, 3140) over the woodspring trap at (2200, 3169) (oploc1,regicide_trap_woodspring, quest_regicide.rs2:31, an agility roll with no condition: a scripted crossing row). The crossing at the camp's west edge, regicide_cross_over3 at (2173, 3156), has no landing on walkable land (the build report's gate rows with no landing).

areas.name: Miscellania and Etceteria

areas.name: Burthorpe Games Room
areas.notes: minigames/game_gamesroom. Entered by the stairs in Burthorpe (board_game_stairs_grey_all at (2899, 3566), ladders+stairs/scripts/stairs.rs2:485), which land on one of six tiles at random (stairs.rs2:491), so sources/connectors.ts derives no landing: gates.ts CURATED_CROSSINGS has the stairs each way. The barmaid is traded with from up to 3 tiles off, across her bar (minigames/game_gamesroom/general/scripts/boardgames_barmaid.rs2:12), so the shop's stand is in front of it.

areas.name: Mage Arena chamber
areas.notes: Below the Mage Arena; areas/area_mage_arena/scripts/chamber.rs2 places the god capes here. Its cellar, with the bank and the rune shop, is the landing of the ladder in the Mage Arena house at (3091, 3957) (oploc1,magearena_ladder_to_cellar, areas/area_mage_arena/scripts/mage_arena.rs2:1, the move at :6), with no condition: a scripted crossing row in the world index, outside ladders+stairs/. The god statues and the staff shop beyond are the sparkling pool's (oploc1,magearena_waterportal1 at (2541, 4719), mage_arena.rs2:15) once the Mage Arena miniquest is done (:59), a gate row in gates.ts.
